The following events took place in '''21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 14''' after the [[Great ReSynchronization]], '''Year 979''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and '''Year 3,632''' after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].

==Events==
*The two-[[Standard year/Legends|year-long]] [[Battle of Mygeeto|battle]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] began.
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]] was [[Battle of Berchest|liberated]] from the Separatists by the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]].
*[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was [[Mission to Ord Cestus|dispatched]] to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] to aid the [[X'Ting]].
*[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] was secretly [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
*The [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] was founded.
*[[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]] was found on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and was delivered to [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].
*[[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]] became [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]].
*[[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] [[Marriage/Legends|marries]] [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun]].<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]] and ''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]'', former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was depicted as being assassinated by [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Sajé Tasha]] aboard the [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]] [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 freighter]] ''[[Star of Iskin]]'', events taking place in 21 BBY.<ref name="Republic61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref> However, Valorum was later shown to be alive in "[[The Lost One]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref> which takes place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="Lost One date">{{FactFile2014|60|20 BBY 67-70|Sifo-Dyas' Legacy}}</ref>
